title: He saved $800 on Black Friday and got $1,200 poorer

scenes.text: Mike saved $800 this Black Friday... and somehow ended up $1,200 poorer.
A TV, 30% off. Headphones, half price. And a jacket he didn't even want... but hey, 70% off!
Total: $1,200, down from $2,000. Mike tells everyone he saved $800.
But he wasn't planning to buy any of it. He didn't save $800. He spent $1,200.
And he paid with buy now, pay later. Four easy payments. He missed one, and the late fees kicked in.
Jake had a list. One thing he actually needed: winter boots, $150. Paid in cash.
The $1,050 he didn't spend? Invested. In 10 years at 8%, that's about $2,267.
If it wasn't on your list, a discount isn't saving. It's just spending.
Follow, and don't let Black Friday shop for you.
